auditor.role: independent i18n auditor (team lopdev, task child 'UI-1 i18n audit r1'); not the translator (coder, anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, per PR #1962 body)
auditor.independence: Session fefddad98e83, a task instance distinct from the translating coder. Served model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 per this session's harness system prompt, no fallback. Judged from the English, its context sidecar, the core glossary and locale style guide at local-operator origin/main, and shipped catalogue precedent; no MT used. Auditor-authored fixes are listed as findings with before/after.

findings.note: Mechanical pass on the audited bytes: key set and order equal English (30); ICU parse OK in intl-messageformat; argument names/types equal English per key; plural arms equal the locale's CLDR cardinal categories (Intl.PluralRules); formats with sample args for counts 0,1,2,5,21,1000000; NFC; no bidi control characters; no em/en dashes.

'Se reconnecter' is this product's shipped fr label for SIGN IN AGAIN (ui.providers.provider_detail.sign_in_again, ui.agents.publication.action.sign_in, ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.sign_in_again); on a button that re-dials the background service it suggests a re-login. Shipped reconnect buttons say 'Reconnecter' (ui.chat.run_details.mcp.control.reconnect, ui.providers.phone.action.reconnect).

fr guide: apostrophe U+2019 and U+202F before : and ?. The file had 12 ASCII apostrophes and 7 plain spaces before :/?; shipped fr is 3773 U+2019 vs 33 ASCII. Normalised in every affected key (listed in before/after).
